name: Limited Spectator
description: Fully configurable server-authoritative spectator mode with flight, distance limits, and customizable restrictions. Required on the server; client install is optional but highly recommended for the best UX (HUD auto-hide and event sync). Vanilla clients can join servers running this mod.
_gameVersionsNote: No single artifact supports both 26.1.2 and 26.2 — Fabric targets 26.2 and NeoForge targets 26.1.2. depends.minecraft is only a floor; the per-file game-version tags set at Modrinth upload time are authoritative for which JAR applies to which Minecraft version.
